items.title: OpenAI’s new ChatGPT feature logs your keystrokes and stores them in plain text
items.summary:
OpenAI has launched Computer History, a ChatGPT feature that records clicks, keystrokes, keyboard shortcuts and app switches on macOS to build a searchable memory. items.title: How to Decide What Work AI Should Do for You: The AI Deputization Audit
items.summary: Two new features — GrokBot's teach-a-task and ChatGPT's Computer History — mark the moment the AI bottleneck officially moved from capability to context. But once your AI can learn how you work, you still have to decide what work it should actually do. NLW proposes a scoring system: the AI deputization audit.
